reviews.title: desk top computer power supply for a modern computer
reviews.comment: Purchased to match with a new MSI motherboard for a self-build desk top computer. Power supply met my expectations and operates continuously and satisfactorily.
reviews.author: Tom Luikens

reviews.title: Great for pre-built PCs
reviews.comment: Works really well. I had a pre-built pc with a really bad PSU. Had to replace it and decided to get this. No problems yet and it’s been around 4 months. It was easy to install and looks like any other PSU. Would recommend
reviews.author: L.

reviews.title: Perfect replacement for my dead PSU in an older ATX 2.x system
reviews.comment: Perfect replacement for my dead PSU in an older ATX 2.x system. I had to rearrange my SATA drives to make the connectors on the shorter SATA cable fit, but the upside is less excess cable hanging loose in the case. The PATA (Molex) cable combined with connectors from the old PSU was used to power a SATA Blu-ray drive that the SATA cable couldn't have reached even if it had a fourth connector, plus a front panel power light and fan and a side case fan. So in my case (pun intended) it had exactly the right number of connectors with none left over except the PCIe, which I didn't use, so it's much less cluttered than before.
reviews.author: E. Leckert
